symptom: ALTER SNIPPET/PAGE could not add a navigation list item: `insert into navList1 { item … }` failed with "failed to insert: failed to build widgets: failed to build widget : item must be a direct child of navigationlist", and `insert after t1 { … }` with t1 inside an existing item failed with `failed to resolve snippet target: widget "t1" not found`; the only workaround was REPLACE of the whole list, retyping every item
cause: Two gaps of one shape: the INSERT built every node as a standalone widget, and the builder refuses a lone `item` (it is only built inside a navigationlist); and the mutator's lookup/scope/data-source walks descended into Widgets, TabPages, ControlBar.Items, … but never a NavigationList's Items, so nothing inside an item was addressable
insight: Every non-widget child list (TabPages #1215, ListView Templates, DataGrid2 columns, now NavigationList Items) needs the same three things: an executor branch before buildWidgetsFromAST, a dedicated mutator insert that wraps the children in a throwaway parent and serializes it so they get CREATE's exact shape, and a descent in all three tree walks (find, scope, nearest data source) — grep the TabPages lines in mutator.go to find every walk at once. The ALTERed snippet's NDSL dump is identical to one CREATEd with both items (the cheapest proof of shape), and mx check 11.12.1 is clean. Items carry no Name (#1373), so BEFORE/AFTER an item is not offered: `insert after t1 { item }` is refused naming the INTO form rather than guessing it meant 'after the item holding t1'. Item names as an addressing feature would need a derived/positional address (cf. layoutContainer.top), not a stored Name.
